What Apple Haptic Touch is — press-and-hold, not pressure

Apple replaced legacy 3D Touch and Force Touch pressure sensitivity on most iPhones with Haptic Touch — a timed press-and-hold with Taptic Engine feedback. Buyers tune how long a press must last under Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Haptic Touch (Fast or Slow). Common surfaces your US listing may show on gallery frames:

  • Home Screen icon long-press — Quick Actions menu, jiggle-mode entry, or widget picker after press-and-hold on an app icon
  • Link and content previews — peek-style long-press on links, messages, or thumbnails that open a preview or context menu
  • Control and menu long-press — press-and-hold on buttons, lists, or tray items that reveal secondary actions
  • Haptic Touch duration toggle — Settings walkthrough showing Fast or Slow under 触感触控 when your app educates buyers about press-and-hold timing

Your gallery may lead with a Home Screen Quick Actions capture on one frame and an in-app long-press menu on the next. zh-Hans caption lines should name the correct surface per frame — a Quick Actions sheet is not Touch Accommodations Hold Duration and not Music Haptics rhythm vibration.

Haptic Touch is not Touch Accommodations, Back Tap, AssistiveTouch, or Music Haptics

Accessibility and interaction apps blur several Settings → Touch rows indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — Haptic Touch press-and-hold marketing on the product page:

  • Haptic Touch (this page) — press-and-hold duration, Home Screen Quick Actions, long-press menus, peek-style previews; Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Haptic Touch; zh-Hans: 触感触控, 轻点并按住, 长按菜单, 触感触控时长, Haptic Touch 快/慢.
  • Touch Accommodations (different) — Hold Duration, Ignore Repeat, Tap Assistance, initial vs final touch location under Touch Accommodations (触控调节). See Touch Accommodations listing guide — motor timing accommodations, not system press-and-hold menu duration.
  • Back Tap (different) — double or triple tap on the physical back of iPhone (轻点背面). See Back Tap listing guide — back-surface triggers, not screen long-press.
  • AssistiveTouch (different) — on-screen floating assistive menu and virtual home button (辅助触控). See AssistiveTouch listing guide — not press-and-hold Quick Actions marketing.
  • Music Haptics (different) — feeling music through rhythm-synced vibration (音乐触感). See Music Haptics listing guide — not Haptic Touch menu duration.
  • Reachability & Shake to Undo (different) — one-handed screen pull-down and shake-to-undo gestures. Separate shop guides — not press-and-hold menu copy unless your screenshot shows those surfaces accurately.
  • Legacy 3D Touch / Force Touch (historical only) — older pressure-based peek-and-pop. Mention only when your English source explains Haptic Touch replaced that hardware — AppLocale does not create a standalone 3D Touch listing page.

Haptic Touch engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume press-and-hold UX in the app covers storefront language. Quick Actions registration and App Store Connect actually separate runtime behavior from product-page copy:

  • Haptic Touch in iOS Settings — system press-and-hold duration under Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Haptic Touch. Buyers pick Fast or Slow. Outside AppLocale scope.
  • Quick Actions & context menus in your app — UIApplicationShortcutItem, UIContextMenuInteraction, or custom long-press handlers in the binary. Engineering scope — not AppLocale.
  • Press-and-hold marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app aligns with Haptic Touch, documents Quick Actions setup, or educates about long-press menus. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of long-press features in the app.

Haptic Touch–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Press-and-hold marketing uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Haptic Touch — not a literal paste of US marketing:

设置 → 辅助功能 → 触控 → 触感触控 (Haptic Touch Fast / Slow)

Apple's Chinese Settings path is 设置 → 辅助功能 → 触控 → 触感触控. Duration options map to commerce terms like Haptic Touch 快 and Haptic Touch 慢, or 触感触控时长 when your gallery shows the duration picker. Do not substitute 触控调节 (Touch Accommodations) or 轻点背面 (Back Tap) on frames that show the Haptic Touch toggle.

轻点并按住 (press and hold)

US pages use "Press and hold" or "Long-press for Quick Actions." China storefront copy uses 轻点并按住 on frames that walk buyers through press-and-hold menus. Pair with 长按菜单 when the screenshot shows a context menu or Home Screen Quick Actions sheet.

触感触控 vs 音乐触感 (Haptic Touch vs Music Haptics)

触感触控 names press-and-hold menu duration under Accessibility → Touch. 音乐触感 names rhythm haptics synced to songs — a different Accessibility feature. Do not keyword-stuff 音乐触感 when English only markets press-and-hold Quick Actions.

Quick Actions & Home Screen long-press

When your English subtitle says "Home Screen Quick Actions" or "Long-press the app icon," zh-Hans buyers search 主屏幕快捷操作, 长按 App 图标, or 快捷操作. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual gallery frames — icon menu vs in-app context menu vs Settings walkthrough.

3D Touch as legacy context only

If your English description notes that Haptic Touch replaced 3D Touch pressure peek, zh-Hans copy may briefly explain the transition — without leading the page as a 3D Touch feature or inventing Force Touch hardware claims your app does not support today.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need press-and-hold search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle. Terms like 触感触控, 轻点并按住, and 长按菜单 each signal different intent from 触控调节 (Touch Accommodations) or 轻点背面 (Back Tap).

Common mistakes on Haptic Touch zh-Hans listings

  • Leaving "Haptic Touch" untranslated — Apple and buyers expect 触感触控 in zh-Hans regions; English-only overlay lines look unfinished
  • Conflating Haptic Touch with Touch Accommodations — 触控调节 and Hold Duration belong on the Touch Accommodations guide; press-and-hold menu duration is this page
  • Conflating Haptic Touch with Music Haptics — 音乐触感 belongs on the Music Haptics guide; menu press-and-hold is not rhythm vibration
  • Machine-translating "long press" as generic 长按 alone — may miss Apple's 轻点并按住 phrasing buyers recognize from Settings
  • Leading with 3D Touch as the hero feature — legacy pressure peek is historical context only; current copy should center Haptic Touch press-and-hold
  • Claiming Quick Actions engineering in listing copy — product-page copy should describe user-facing press-and-hold benefits, not UIApplicationShortcutItem API documentation
  • Assuming long-press UX localizes the store page — engineering and App Store metadata are independent workstreams

AppLocale FAQ

What is Haptic Touch and why does listing copy matter?

Haptic Touch is press-and-hold with haptic feedback — Home Screen Quick Actions, long-press menus, and peek-style previews — with duration under Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Haptic Touch. Marketing that on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does changing Haptic Touch speed auto-translate my China listing?

No. Haptic Touch Fast or Slow is a system setting — it does not fill App Store Connect localization rows. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is this different from Touch Accommodations?

Touch Accommodations covers Hold Duration, Ignore Repeat, and Tap Assistance (触控调节). Haptic Touch covers press-and-hold menu duration and Quick Actions (触感触控). Different Accessibility → Touch rows — see Touch Accommodations listing (zh-Hans) when motor timing is your lead.

How is this different from Back Tap, AssistiveTouch, or Music Haptics?

Back Tap is physical back-surface triggers (轻点背面). AssistiveTouch is the floating on-screen menu (辅助触控). Music Haptics is rhythm vibration synced to songs (音乐触感). This page covers screen press-and-hold menus and 触感触控 duration only.

Should I still mention 3D Touch?

Only as brief legacy context when your English source explains Haptic Touch replaced 3D Touch pressure. AppLocale does not lead with 3D Touch marketing or create a dedicated 3D Touch listing page.

Does AppLocale implement Quick Actions or long-press code?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. Quick Actions, context menus, and haptic feedback in Xcode are outside AppLocale scope.

What do I send after payment?

Your live App Store listing URL, current English listing copy, screenshot overlay lines mentioning Haptic Touch or press-and-hold, target locales (e.g. zh-Hans), and deadline. Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt.

Is this machine translation?

No. We rewrite Haptic Touch and press-and-hold listing copy by hand. We do not paste Google Translate or ChatGPT output into deliverables.
